note: The best-made windrunner found in this batch. Genuine 2-layer waterproof shell, fully seam-sealed, double YKK waterproof zips, 3M reflective piping on torso and back, adjustable toggle hem. Corteiz building actual technical outerwear rather than a printed shell, and there is a matching APEX SHELL PANT if the full kit is wanted.

title: ELITEWORK™ WATERPROOF SHELL JACKET V2 [KHAKI]
note: The V2 of the Elitework shell - front vents, concealed left-arm zip pocket, waterproof YKK zips, reflective print on the upper panels. Khaki makes it the quiet-shell option that a loud top can sit under. Full M-XXL run in stock.

title: MINI ISLAND HOODIE TRACKSUIT [HEATHER GREY]
note: 440GSM 100% cotton with a thick fleece lining, YKK metal zippers, coverstitch throughout, boxy relaxed hood. This is what a heavyweight tracksuit should weigh - most brands at this price are 300GSM. Heather grey is the neutral base that will carry a loud shoe.

title: GUERILLAZ CARGO PANT [NAVY]
note: 100% cotton ripstop, relaxed fit, bare (unlogo'd) pockets with only a screen print on the back. The cleanest cargo in the batch and directly in Dave's priority bottoms lane. Sized 28-38 in stock.

title: WITHERED GREEN ‘OXYGEN’ PADDED ZIP-UP HOODIE
note: 14oz cotton with circular EVA padding, waffle-thermal lining, a double-layered hood and small removable shoulder pads. Nobody else in this batch is building a hoodie like this - it is closer to outerwear than a sweatshirt. Also made in stealth black, fruit punch, canary and bubblegum if the loud version is wanted.

title: 'PINCH' BOOTS IN PACIFIC BLACK
note: Heavyweight genuine cowhide suede with a soft napped hand, layered shroud with Badson's patterned darts, three chrome snap-button closures over a rubber sole. Real footwear design from a clothing label, and the deepest size run of any shoe here (5-11+).

title: ‘CORE’ PUFFER JACKET IN WEATHERED BLUE LEATHER
note: The single best-made piece in this batch regardless of price: 100% sheepskin leather with an intensive faded-blue rub-off wash, filled 95% duck down / 5% feather, muted silver placket snaps, removable shoulder pads. Expensive but not overpriced - the materials are all there.

title: The “Street Sweeper” Bomber Jacket - Black Reflective
note: Waterproof reflective bomber/trench hybrid, limited to 100 units, and the widest size run in the batch (XXS-4XL). Gabos is the strongest UK shell/technical lead to come out of the Instagram work and this is their headline piece.

title: Grey "Money Mitch" Full Tracksuit
note: Soft heavyweight cotton, collared top rather than a hood, and flared bottoms with ankle zips that open the leg out. A genuinely different tracksuit shape from the Corteiz/Nike template, in four colourways. Ships as a true two-piece set.

title: Rio League Track Jacket
note: Nylon with a full internal mesh lining, funnel neck, full-zip, contrast panelling and front-and-back embroidery - a proper football-terrace track jacket rather than a printed windbreaker. Matching Rio League pants and shorts exist, so it builds a set. Full XS-3XL run.

title: Olive Hybrid Jersey
note: Three-in-one layered construction - mesh over waffle thermal over French terry - with individually handset rhinestones on the back logo and embroidered side patches. The most interesting piece of construction found in the whole Instagram batch, and olive makes it the quiet half of a loud-top/quiet-leg fit.

title: SKTP.01 - BROWN (Boo Johnson)
note: Chad Muska's SUPRA Skytop redrawn for Straye: hairy suede upper, extra-tall foxing, chunky lifted sole, padded collar and tongue. A genuine skate high-top with real heritage at $110, and it comes in seven colourways so the neutral or the loud version is available.

title: ARCH QUARTER ZIP (ASH HEATHER)
note: Half-zip from a long-running real streetwear label at $72 - the cheapest thing on this list and still one of the best. Ash heather is a true mid-grey neutral, which is exactly the quiet middle layer the outfit grammar needs. M/L/XL in stock.

title: (SAMPLE) ZIP UP KEFFIYEH HOODIE - SAND
note: Thick 100% cotton zip hoodie with a real keffiyeh scarf sewn into the garment. Nothing else in the catalog does this - a genuinely original idea executed on a heavy blank, small run, Small-2XL. Also in red and the America colourway.

title: OG Cartel Denim Black
note: The core of Asaali's denim programme, sized 28-42 - one of the few brands here running a real jeans block rather than a single wash. The laser-engraved and monogram all-over-print versions sit alongside it if the loud denim is wanted.

title: STEEL EMBOSSED HEAVYWEIGHT WORK JACKET
note: Heavyweight embossed work jacket from an established LA label - one of only 45 pieces still in stock out of Menace's 841-product catalog, so treat the rest of that store as an archive board and this as the live buy. Also in orange for the loud version.
